question: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?
gold_query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE ID IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend) AND ID IN (SELECT liked_id FROM Likes)"}

final_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE ID IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend) AND ID IN (SELECT liked_id FROM Likes)
explain: The SQL correctly identifies high schoolers who have friends (ID in Friend.student_id) AND are liked (ID in Likes.liked_id) by using two independent subqueries within the WHERE clause.
